t_mm[n] = +1/√T (constant)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="600" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_chart_bg" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#cccccc;fontSize=10;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="220" x="600" y="250" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_axis" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1;" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="605" y="285" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="815" y="285" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_high" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#82b366;strokeColor=#82b366;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="5" width="210" x="605" y="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_lbl_hi" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=9;html=1;" value="+1/√T" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="14" width="35" x="780" y="262" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_lbl_1s" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=8;html=1;align=right;" value="1 s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="12" width="25" x="790" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t0_corr" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" value="c_0[n] = ⟨e_d[n:n+T], t_bit0⟩
fftconvolve(mode='valid')
peaks when sample n is the start
of a 100-ms dip" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="260" x="40" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t1_corr" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" value="c_1[n] = ⟨e_d[n:n+T], t_bit1⟩
fftconvolve(mode='valid')
peaks when sample n is the start
of a 200-ms dip" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="260" x="320" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_corr" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" value="c_mm[n] = Σ e_d[n:n+T] / √T
1-s moving sum (via cumsum)
positive when envelope is
above local mean (no dip)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="220" x="600" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t0_link" edge="1" parent="1" source="t0_chart_bg" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#666;strokeWidth=1;dashed=1;" target="t0_corr"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t1_link" edge="1" parent="1" source="t1_chart_bg" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#666;strokeWidth=1;dashed=1;" target="t1_corr"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tmm_link" edge="1" parent="1" source="tmm_chart_bg" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#666;strokeWidth=1;dashed=1;" target="tmm_corr"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bus_label" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=10;fontStyle=2;align=center;html=1;" value="e_d feeds all three correlators in parallel" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="14" width="320" x="280" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bus_left" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="170" y="180" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="650" y="155" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="170" y="190" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bus_mid" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="450" y="180" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="650" y="155" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="450" y="190" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bus_right" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="710" y="180" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="650" y="155" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="710" y="190" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="phase_box" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;" value="Phase lock (1 Hz second grid)

Real bit pulses start at samples φ, φ+1000, φ+2000, ... for some unknown φ ∈ [0, T).

φ = argmax over φ ∈ [0, T) of Σₖ max(c_0[φ + k·T], c_1[φ + k·T])
 coherent sum over hundreds of bit boundaries → noise averages out
 implementation: bit_score.reshape(n_secs, T).sum(axis=0).argmax()" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="780" x="40" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_c0_phase" edge="1" parent="1" source="t0_corr" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.2;entryY=0;" target="phase_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_c1_phase" edge="1" parent="1" source="t1_corr" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.45;entryY=0;" target="phase_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="decision_box" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;" value="Per-second decision at the grid positions idx = φ + k·T, k = 0, 1, 2 ...

 s0, s1, sm = c_0[idx], c_1[idx], c_mm[idx]
 bit_score = max(s0, s1) absent_thr = 0.2 · median(bit_score)
 bit_value = 1 if s1 > s0 else 0 ← linear discriminant (templates are linearly independent, 48° angle)

 if bit_score < absent_thr AND sm > 0:
 label = MINUTE_MARK ( no pulse this second, AND envelope sat above the 2-s mean )
 else:
 label = bit_value ( BIT_0 or BIT_1 )" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="780" x="40" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_phase_dec" edge="1" parent="1" source="phase_box" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;" target="decision_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_cmm_dec" edge="1" parent="1" source="tmm_corr" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.85;entryY=0;" target="decision_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="710" y="430" /> <mxPoint x="703" y="590" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="walker_box" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;" value="Frame walker (per-second label stream)

 BIT_0 / BIT_1 → append to bit buffer (overflow past 59 ⇒ discard buffer)
 MINUTE_MARK → if buffer has exactly 59 bits:
 _decode_frame: framing (bit[0]==0, bit[20]==1, bit[17]⊕bit[18]==1)
 even-parity over (21..28), (29..35), (36..58)
 BCD-decode minute / hour / day / weekday / month / year
 plausibility ranges check
 if all checks pass: append FrameDecode to frames list
 reset buffer regardless" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="780" x="40" y="790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_dec_walker" edge="1" parent="1" source="decision_box" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;" target="walker_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="output_box" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=6;" value="locked = latest frame in frames list (None if empty)

Returned dict: year / month / day / weekday / hour / minute / dst_active
 + locked, signal_present, valid_pulses, frames_decoded" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="780" x="40" y="1020" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_walker_out" edge="1" parent="1" source="walker_box" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeColor=#000;strokeWidth=2;" target="output_box"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Phase lock (1 Hz second grid)
Real bit pulses start at samples φ, φ+1000, φ+2000, ... for some unknown φ ∈ [0, T).
φ = argmax over φ ∈ [0, T) of Σₖ max(c_0[φ + k·T], c_1[φ + k·T])
coherent sum over hundreds of bit boundaries → noise averages out
implementation: bit_score.reshape(n_secs, T).sum(axis=0).argmax()

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Per-second decision at the grid positions idx = φ + k·T, k = 0, 1, 2 ...
s0, s1, sm = c_0[idx], c_1[idx], c_mm[idx]
bit_score = max(s0, s1) absent_thr = 0.2 · median(bit_score)
bit_value = 1 if s1 > s0 else 0 ← linear discriminant (templates are linearly independent, 48° angle)
if bit_score < absent_thr AND sm > 0:
label = MINUTE_MARK ( no pulse this second, AND envelope sat above the 2-s mean )
else:
label = bit_value ( BIT_0 or BIT_1 )

div.div:
Frame walker (per-second label stream)
BIT_0 / BIT_1 → append to bit buffer (overflow past 59 ⇒ discard buffer)
MINUTE_MARK → if buffer has exactly 59 bits:
_decode_frame: framing (bit[0]==0, bit[20]==1, bit[17]⊕bit[18]==1)
even-parity over (21..28), (29..35), (36..58)
BCD-decode minute / hour / day / weekday / month / year
plausibility ranges check
if all checks pass: append FrameDecode to frames list
reset buffer regardless
